name: search_jobs
description: Search the person's Jobhunt feed: open jobs read from employers' own boards, ranked against their profile. Returns up to `limit` jobs with match percent, pay, place, visa facts and each job's id.

query.description: Words to find in the title, company, place or department.

us_only.description: Leave out jobs located only outside the United States. Defaults to the person's profile setting.

h1b_filer_only.description: Only employers with recent certified H-1B filings whose posting names no visa limit.

hide_visa_blockers.description: Leave out postings that ask for citizenship or a clearance, or say they will not sponsor.

name: get_job
description: Read one job in full: the posting text, the match breakdown with reasons, what the posting says about sponsorship, citizenship, clearance and E-Verify, which resume in the library fits it best, and that resume's text. Read this before writing anything for a job.

name: get_profile
description: The person's profile: target titles, skills, years, level and whether they need visa sponsorship.

name: list_resumes
description: The resumes in the person's library, with each one's id, skills and titles.

name: get_resume
description: The full text of one resume from the library.

name: save_document
description: Save something you wrote for a job back into Jobhunt, where it appears on that job. Use only facts from the person's resume: the result lists any skill or figure the resume does not back up, and you should fix those and save again. kind is one of: fit (a short fit summary), resume (a tailored resume), cover (a cover letter), message (an outreach message).

content.description: The full text, plain text or Markdown.

name: update_tracker
description: Move a job in the person's application tracker, or add a note to it. Only do this when the person asks.
